content: The Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ), as part of the Affordable Care Act (ACA), developed a National Quality Strategy aimed at improving healthcare quality through three primary objectives: enhancing population health, improving patient care, and reducing per capita healthcare costs. To evaluate the quality of diabetes care effectively, it is crucial to combine traditional disease-specific metrics with assessments of patient experience and healthcare costs. This comprehensive evaluation framework enables a more holistic approach to managing diabetes, addressing not only clinical outcomes but also patient-centered care and economic considerations.
